headline: A very large meeting (about 700 items): 9(4) endorsements already approved for others issued within two working days; last chance to merge duplicate CROP accounts and complete KYC; strict action on fake lab reports; scrutiny templates sent for comments.

changes.d: 9(4) endorsements of changes already approved by the RC (shelf life, packaging, import source, crops, etc.) go straight to the Secretary and are issued within two working days, with ex-post-facto RC approval. CGG to build the CROP module.

changes.t: 9(3) and 9(4) registrants treated alike after registration
changes.d: Once registered, the same endorsement guidelines apply to all registrants, whatever their registration category.

changes.t: Duplicate CROP accounts and KYC: last chance
changes.d: Holders of duplicate or deficient accounts get one last chance, within 30 days of the minutes, to say which account stays and to complete KYC; requests to merge accounts and revive frozen ones to be made in 30 days.

Fake or fabricated institute/lab reports will be verified and lead to strong legal action. Show-cause notices to Meghmani (forged Sulphur CR) and Sunshine Fine Chemsol (fake test report); illegal Methyl Bromide trade complaint taken up.
Draft templates for scrutinising each category were approved for stakeholder comments (finalised in the 472nd).
After FSSAI's SPPR raised data-integrity concerns, a committee will inspect certain residue-study laboratories.

changes.t: Fast Track export certificates show quantities and compositions
changes.d: Import-for-export CRs and labels now state the product and quantity to be imported and exported and the chemical compositions of both.
The Secretariat to draft guidelines and a form for export permits, like import permits (approved in the 472nd).

changes.t: Old labels during the new packaging rule
changes.d: Existing label stock may be used during the transition to GSR 368(E) of 03.06.2025.

Glyphosate 41% SL on tea: PHI cut from 21 to 7 days. Renofluthrin 5% MUP may be used for coil, incense stick and vaporiser formulations. Lebanon has banned Oxamyl. 9(3B) extensions approved subject to data-generation progress.

actions: CROP: merge duplicate accounts and complete KYC within 30 days of the minutes.
Endorsements of already-approved changes: apply on CROP; expect the letter in two working days.
Keep original lab reports ready for verification.
